name: page-header
description: Standard page heading: optional breadcrumbs, level-1 title, description, right-aligned actions and a sub-row slot.
designIntent: Every list/detail page repeats breadcrumb + title + description + actions with drifting spacing. PageHeader fixes the hierarchy (one h1 per page) and the responsive wrap, so pages stay consistent.

examples.title: List page header
examples.code:
<PageHeader
  title="Classes"
  description="Manage your weekly schedule."
  breadcrumbs={<Breadcrumb … />}
  actions={<Button>New class</Button>}
/>

antiPatterns.title: Don't stack multiple h1s
antiPatterns.explanation: PageHeader renders the page's h1; section headings inside the page should be h2 via Heading.

accessibility.userRequirements: Use Heading level={2} for sections below

badExamples: Here you can manage all of your classes

compositionRules.relationship: Pass a Breadcrumb as breadcrumbs for hierarchy context
